fact: At the mission of 30 September to 4 October 2024, one digital-skills training programme for public agents had been run (target five by end-2026) and 367 officials and beneficiaries had been trained under the project (target 2,000).
title: Mission d'appui à la mise en œuvre et de revue à mi-parcours, Projet de gouvernance numérique du secteur public (PGNSP), Aide-mémoire
